rules: New components consume root tokens and do not invent page-wide theme state.
New animations consume animation-root duration/easing tokens and honor reduced motion.
Camera transitions consume the camera-root timing contract.
Physical UI objects consume the UI-object root and map to semantic object IDs.
Theme changes cannot change roles, permissions, routes, business logic, payment state, data authority, or security.
Responsive behavior changes layout density and composition, never semantic identity or access policy.
Physical object state transitions are explicit and invalid transitions retain current state.
Responsive transformation changes layout/presentation only and preserves semantic object identity.
Animation timing comes from the animation root; components do not invent page-local timing contracts.
